name: SettingRow
usage: Application settings, conversation settings, personal preferences, on/off options

props.name: description
props.description: Description: what the setting affects and what the values mean.

props.name: control
props.description:
Control on the right: Switch, Select, InputNumber, Button and the like. The form controls of the library
placed here take `title` as their accessible name and `description` as their accessible description, so they
need no `aria-label` of their own. A control's own `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is kept, buttons keep
their own text, and a control in a Form.Item with its own `label` and `name` keeps that label as its name.

props.name: children
props.description: Additional content below the control (such as expanded sub-settings).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Name and description on the left, the control on the right; dividers are added between rows automatically.
The control needs no `aria-label`: screen readers announce it with the title and the description of the row.
